name: Maladetas
format: 16-bit grayscale PNG, preserved as .png.bytes to prevent Unity image conversion
suppliedData: height only; no PBR materials, splat weights, land-cover classes, CRS or georeferenced bounds
attribution: Terrain Descriptors for Landscape Synthesis, Analysis and Simulation, Oscar Argudo, Eric Guerin, Hugo Schott, Eric Galin, Eurographics 2025. Upstream README lists ICGC, CNIG, swissALTI3D and USGS as high-resolution DEM providers, without assigning an individual provider to each PNG. Preserve source attribution; the repository code's MIT license is not asserted to be a blanket CC0 license for the DEM collection.
